The W07-06 helper `readOwnerInventory` (INVENTORY_PAGE_ROWS=1000, empty-page proof, INCOMPLETE on error/clamp/repeat/budget) existed in the same file but had no caller in the deletion path. Apple revocation was already sequenced before RevenueCat/Auth (base ~522-547) — preserved and now pinned by a route test. legal.ts §7/§8 + support already disclosed ledger survival, but the support page did not say what is retained and Terms §8 (free allowance) and §12 (termination) did not state that used free ratings are not restored — parity gap with the in-app confirmation. Fix (commit 21f051b7 + b5519d14): `ACCOUNT_OWNER_NAMESPACES` (16 owner-keyed public tables from the migrations: profiles, sessions, shots, shot_phases, shot_measurements, shot_checkpoints, captures, analysis_permits, analysis_permit_tombstones, consent_records, evaluation_trials, analysis_feedback, user_saved_drills, player_rank_state, billing_entitlements, account_deletion_feedback) each read through `verifyOwnerNamespacesEmpty` → `readOwnerInventory` with keyset (PostgREST `or=(…)`) cursors after the durable receipt AND again when an already-completed operation is re-confirmed; residue or an unread namespace keeps `completion_unverified` (retryable 503, generic body, table/count detail only in the operator log via the existing onFailure sink); `ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNREAD_TABLES` records account_external_credentials + account_deletion_requests as cascade_from_profiles (PK → profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE) and free_rating_ledger + webhook_events as retained. New required dependency `readOwnerNamespacePage` wired in index.ts confirmAccountDeletion with adminDb (service role). legal.ts: support names the one-way hash + scored-analysis count and points to Privacy §7; Terms §8 and §12 say used free ratings are not restored by deleting and signing in again with the same Apple or Google account (no prohibited claims; checked by the parity test).
